name: Add Organic Search Filter to SCO - UI
description:
As WFM, I want a filter feature on the Search screen that allows the customer to narrow their search to just organic items so that customers can locate items faster.

This Story covers the UI changes.

### Background: 
Business is requesting that the current organic search filter available on registers today be added to the SCO Item Search experience within the keyboard (see Figma). This will enable customers to limit returned search results to just organic products helping them locate items faster.

### User Journey
**DOD 1: (UI) While configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” is ‘off’, Organic toggle slide displays in off position**
1.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to ‘SHOW_OFF’
2.	At Attract, press Search button
3.	Search screen displays
4.	Verify the new filter feature displays on the Search keyboard to the right of the Enter button (see Figma for properties):
a)	Title: Organic
b)	Toggle slide left of title is off (color=white)
c)	Entry field is shortened to accommodate the new toggle

**DOD 2: (UI) While configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” is ‘on’, Organic toggle slide displays in on position**
1.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to ‘SHOW_ON’
2.	At Attract, press Search button
3.	Search screen displays
4.	Verify the new filter feature displays on the Search keyboard to the right of the Enter button (see Figma for properties):
a)	Title: Organic
b)	Toggle slide left of title is on (color=green)
c)	Entry field is shortened to accommodate the new toggle

**DOD 3: (UI) While configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” is ‘not show’, Organic toggle slide does not display**
1.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to ‘HIDE’
2.	At Attract, press Search button
3.	Search screen displays
4.	Verify the new filter feature does not display and Entry field is at its normal length

parentTasks.name: Add Organic Search Filter to SCO
parentTasks.description:
As WFM, I want a filter feature on the Search screen that allows the customer to narrow their search to just organic items so that customers can locate items faster.

### Background: 
Business is requesting that the current organic search filter available on registers today be added to the SCO Item Search experience within the keyboard (see Figma). This will enable customers to limit returned search results to just organic products helping them locate items faster.

### Requirements
•	As a Business, we want an organic toggle to be added to the SCO item search keyboard that limits search results to just organic products when turned on.
•	As a Business, we want customer engagement with the toggle to be tracked within usability to enable a better understanding for the business in terms of how much value this provides customers.
•	As a Business, we want the organic toggle to be delivered to WFM as "hide" (organic toggle does not display on keyboard.
•	As a Business, we want the organic toggle to be configurable as "off" (or “on”) where the organic toggle is set to off (or on) at the beginning of each customer transaction.
•	As a Business, during the customers transaction we want the ability for the organic filter to remain on/off for the entirety of the customers transaction according to customer selection (i.e organic filter remains on if customer turns on for the entirety of that customers transaction) or be configurable to resetting the organic filter to off with each item search use (i.e. organic filter defaults to off after a selection is made and customer returns back to main sales mode screen).

Mocks in Figma Hand-off File 

### Assumptions
1.	This effort is for touchpoint group: SCO
2.	This effort will impact Amazon store brand Amazon Grocery.
3.	The picklist received from R10 will have conventional and organic items paired, ranked and sorted.
4.	With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to SEARCH, any time the customer moves away from the Search screen, by either selecting an item or pressing the Back button, the toggle is to reset back to default if customer returns to Search screen.
5.	With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to SEARCH, if the customer searches for an item but gets message “Item Not Found”, the toggle is not reset to default since the customer is still on the Search screen.
6.	Multi-Version Impact - No impact
7.	Threat model changes - No impact
8.	Performance testing is required to test toggling to organic only search.
9.	Delivery: This epic will be delivered as part of installation package. Configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” will be delivered in “HIDE” state and configuration “OrganicFilterScope” will be delivered in SEARCH state.

### Configurations
**OrganicSearchFilter:** Create a new parameter that allows WFM to configure the organic toggle slide on Search screen to either 1) display with filter on (SHOW_ON), 2) display with filter off (SHOW_OFF), or 3) to not display the toggle slide at all (HIDE) at the store level. Defaulted to HIDE.

**OrganicFilterScope:** Create a new that allows WFM to control the display method used for the organic filter toggle at the store level. Values are TXN and SEARCH. If TXN is selected, the organic filter will remain on/off for the entirety of the transaction according to customer’s selection. If SEARCH is selected, the organic filter is reset to default setting ON/OFF with each item search use. Defaulted to SEARCH.

### What to demo
1.	Using the new configuration “OrganicSearchFilter”, WFM can configure the organic filter toggle to 1) not display in the UI, 2) display but be set to off, or 3) display but set to on.
2.	When the configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” is set to display (on or off), the filtering toggle appears on the Search screen to allow the customer to search for all items or only organic items.
3.	Using the new configuration “OrganicFilterScope”, WFM can also control the display method used for the organic filter toggle.
a.	When configured to TXN, the organic filter will remain on/off for the entirety of the transaction according to customer’s selection.
b.	When configured to SEARCH, the organic filter is reset to default setting ON/OFF with each item search use
4.	Customer engagement with the organic filter toggle is tracked in the Usability Tracking file.
